module.title: operational Geospace model: global magnetosphere coupled to ionospheric electrodynamics, the Rice Convection Model and the radiation belt model (GM+IE+IM/RCM2+RB)
module.expensive_path: measured on test_swpc_pe with 2 ranks (285 s): 36 percent in IE_run, the Ridley_serial ionospheric potential solver (iono_solver, a 2-D elliptic solve on the 181x361 grid every coupling), 31 percent in IE_GM_couple, the field-line tracing from the GM inner boundary to the ionosphere that builds the mapping (GM/srcInterface GM_get_for_ie and the ray tracing in ModFieldTrace), 24 percent in GM_run (BATSRUS explicit advance over the 8^3 blocks), 2 percent in IM_run (RCM2 advection of the plasma-sheet distribution); the coupling exchanges themselves are point-to-point MPI transfers of the ionosphere potential and the field-aligned currents
module.rationale: one module owns the coupled system that SWPC runs operationally: the two-way GM-IE (field-aligned currents to potential, potential to inner-boundary velocity), GM-IM (field-line volumes and plasma-sheet pressure) and IE-IM couplings and the RCM2, Ridley_serial and RBE components with the SWPC input set; every test in the family is the same 2014-04-10 event with a different GM equation set or inner-magnetosphere option
excluded: FLEKS embedded PIC in the SWPC configuration, test_swpc_aepic (swmf-mhd-epic)
hazards: test_swpc_gpu and test_swpc_large_gpu are GPU-compatible builds run on the CPU here (Config.pl -o=GM:opt=... bakes the PARAM.in into the executable); the -large variant is a performance check whose reference tolerance still applies
Ridley_serial has no LICENSE file, only the University of Michigan copyright header
with 2 ranks the COMPONENTMAP puts GM, IE and IM on the same PEs; the timing split changes with rank count
